concept: AWS Budgets: alerts on forecasted overspend
tests: Choosing a service for alerts when forecasted monthly spend exceeds a threshold.
expected: AWS Budgets with alerts on actual and forecasted cost. Triggers: "alerted", "forecast to exceed a threshold", "minimal setup".
why_not: CloudWatch billing metric — actuals only, lower-level; CUR — raw data without alerts; Trusted Advisor — recommendations.
